reason: The arithmetic holds but the claimed range is inflated at the top and the lab test proves nothing. (1) Closed form: E[D+] = mu*Phi(mu/s) + s*phi(mu/s). mu 0.002, s 0.004 gives +0.00279, so the hypothesis number is right. At mu = 0 the value is 0.399*s, which is the hard ceiling of the diversification premium. (2) Plugging the refined sigma formula into the recomputed per-embryo lab deltas (GT-edge weighted; ef 44b6 +0.01374 vs 6bba +0.01630; stitch ~+0.0012 vs ~+0.0025; leaf prune +0.00087 vs +0.00047; transfer slope k = 0.26) gives these sigmas: ef 0.0029, stitch 0.0018, leaf prune 0.0013. The matching E[D+] at mu = 0 is ef +0.00116, stitch +0.00072, leaf prune +0.00051. At mu = -0.0015 they fall to +0.00056, +0.00021 and +0.00007. The claimed '+0.0012..+0.0020' needs sigma 0.003-0.005, which is above the refined formula's own output. A realistic top is ~+0.0012. (3) The success criterion ('premium >= +0.0005 over near-copies') is circular. The noise floor alone, sqrt(0.0011^2 + 0.0004^2) = 0.00117, already gives E[D+] = 0.00047, and any embryo heterogeneity pushes it over. At mu ~ 0 the ranking is by sigma, which the inputs fix (ef > stitch > leaf prune), so the x0.5 / x2 sweep cannot change it. The 'test' only restates the priors and cannot fail. (4) The claimed gain is measured against the wrong counterfactual. If the edge filter ties publicly (exp49 at 0.947-0.949), Kaggle's auto-pick of the 2 best public, and the informal CONTEXT section 11a hedge, already give {exp48, exp49}, which is the diversified pair. So in the rule's 'best case' its extra value over the default is ~0. The real added value is in the ef-wins case: it stops F1/F2 from being near-copies such as two coordhead/ef variants (premium +0.0002 -> ~+0.0005..+0.0007). (5) Scale: the gap to target is 0.97 - 0.948 = 0.022, and the rule is capped at ~0.4*sigma <= 0.0012, i.e. <6% of the gap. It survives only because it costs nothing in the pipeline and at most one probe. Because the private LB is dense (139 teams at 0.948, 33 at 0.953), +0.0005 of private can still move many places.
